sudoku.name: Sudoku
sudoku.desc: Choose a 4×4, 6×6 or 9×9 board so no row, column or box repeats.
sudoku.rules: The 4×4 board uses 2×2 boxes, the 6×6 board uses 2×3 boxes, and the 9×9 board uses 3×3 boxes. Every row, column and box must contain 1 through the board size exactly once. Choose a digit, then apply it to one or more empty cells; switch between Candidates and Fill to choose how it is recorded.

kakuro.name: Kakuro
kakuro.desc: Fill by the clue sums in the black cells: each run uses distinct digits 1–9 that add up exactly.
kakuro.rules: The number at a black cell's top right is the sum of the run to its right; bottom left is the sum of the run below. Digits 1–9, no repeats within a run — broken runs turn red. Start with the smallest or largest sums (a two-cell run of 3 can only be 1+2).

magic-square.name: Magic square
magic-square.desc: Place 1 to n² in the grid so every row, column and diagonal has the same sum.
magic-square.rules: Each number is used exactly once; every row, column and both diagonals must equal the magic sum. Compute it first (total of all numbers ÷ rows), then work from the diagonals and the centre.

live.m3AcceptanceBody: One package-level capability contract covers mixed Mofaxiao pages and embedded Aixuexi pages; the active pointer or drawing tool automatically owns unregistered fallbacks.
live.h5CheckTap: Tap the Mofaxiao page background to trigger its page interaction; an H5 tap only increments once
live.h5CheckTakeover: In either adapter, drag out from the H5 button to create one stroke without incrementing
live.h5CheckReloadFallback: On an unregistered page, the pointer keeps native H5 taps while a pen or color enters ink lock
live.videoSurfaceAction: Play or pause video; drag to write
live.m2HandFeelBody: Write short strokes, long strokes, and sharp turns on both boards, then try erase and undo. Your hand feel is the acceptance result.
live.m2RecoveryBody: Status follows the active main or side board; the PII-free side-board fixture remains available. Reload waits for the active board to be safely stored on this device.
